name: io.github.shibbirweb/mcp-mysql-read-only
title: MySQL (read-only, switchable)
description: Read-only MySQL access, with the database and server switchable mid-conversation.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the MySQL server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the MySQL server. Defaults to 3306

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_USER
environmentVariables.description: MySQL user. Prefer an account holding only SELECT grants

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for MYSQL_USER. Empty when the account has none

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Database to open at startup. Can be changed later without restarting

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: JSON object of named connections to switch between, keyed by profile name

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_DEFAULT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which MYSQL_PROFILES entry to start on

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Server-side query timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000
